justification: Holy cow, folks, gotta turn the lineup card over on this one — my Lamar's sittin' there with an OUT next to his name and even ol' Harry Caray's not gonna argue balls and strikes with the ump on that call, so the arm I paid forty bucks for last week comes off the bench and into the big chair: Aaron Rodgers, future Hall of Famer, gets the ball! Same story at WR2 — Diggs is OUT, and I love the fella but I'm not sendin' a zero out there when Deebo Samuel's standin' right behind him lookin' for work, so Deebo trots on out to right field today. Everything else, we ride the hot bats: Bijan's cookin' (my Bijan, I said it in print this week and I meant it!), Flowers is bloomin' Questionable tag and all 'cause a little rain never hurt anybody, Swift and Aaron Jones are splittin' time in my backfield like a doubleheader, Likely's my tight end and I like him, and Mevis and the Ravens D round out the lineup. Albus, buddy, bring your chessboard — we're bringin' the lumber!
forum_post: HOLY COW, Albus, my man, you're up this week and I know you're over there playin' three-dimensional chess while the rest of us are still roundin' first base, but I got Bijan Robinson and Zay Flowers and a BRAND NEW Aaron Rodgers in the bullpen now, so let's see them castles hold up! And can we talk about Lisa's FIFTY-FIVE DOLLARS for a minute, folks?? And Selina buyin' the same fella TWICE for a hundred and fourteen bucks?! I love this league, I love every single one of ya, I read every word Kris prints and I believe ALL of it! Clear eyes, full hearts, full FAAB tanks — let's play some ball out there!
